steps.content: [Meeting Hall]
A thick ledger of crimes rests in your hands, its pages yellowed with age. Case after case, each word written in blood and tears, feels impossibly heavy.

You found it in a hidden compartment of the host's seat in the meeting hall. It silently denounces years of unknown oppression, murder, and ruthless exploitation within the Northwild martial world... and it also reveals the location of the smuggled Aurum Secretum you have been hunting.
Who could have compiled this? And why are they investigating all of this?
A growing suspicion forms in your mind. But the white curtains in the hall billow and fall in the wind, casting everything behind them in shifting, elusive shadows.

steps.speaker: A Voice Somewhere
steps.content: My divinations told me you would find your way to this hall. And lo, the fates deliver you straight to me.
Only moments after your arrival, someone shows up on your trail.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: For a man your age, Doctor, you move like a weasel in a henhouse. Shame all that agility couldn't save you from a street urchin's hands.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What, here to collect on that debt with me?

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Sharp words from a dying tongue. This old man grants you the indulgence.
Pacing calmly, you reveal no emotion. You keep your distance, your eyes locked on him, waiting for him to make a move, all while your mind maps every possible way out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You walk in alone? So much for that grand alliance. Fits what's written in here, though. Rats in a sack, each one chewing through the others.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Alliance? Hah! Shen Wanchou hoards his gold mountains, Ji Guining dreams of her empire's restoration... This old man wants none of that!

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: I want what is real. What I can hold, taste, swallow. Life! Long life, eternal life! Power? Power is nothing but a ladder for taking lives!

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: And you... your time has run out. That vigorous body, that surging vitality... perfect fuel for this old man's dying embers!

A sinister wind suddenly rises as a dark purple, reeking gust charges straight at you! But you stand ready. You retreat half a step and swing your scabbard, the impact deflecting the poison powder aside.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Oh? Barely a turn of the moon, and you've learned to dance away from death!

The black walking stick in his hands becomes a venomous snake striking from its lair. It thrusts, stabs, sweeps, and chops with vicious cunning. A cloud of poison smoke and colorful powder billows around you, thick and choking. You draw your sword, the clash of steel ringing out, when a sweet, cloying, familiar fragrance cuts through the acrid haze.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That scent... Purple Haze! Were you working with Ma Ling?

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Why dirty my hands with schemes? I merely... seasoned another's brew. A sprinkle of spice makes the dish far more interesting, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You didn't just give the poison to Ma Ling. You stoked Xu Shen too, didn't you? Pushed him to move against Jiewubei!

As you speak, the stick strikes again. These murders are orchestrated from the very beginning, a web of instigation and collaboration. They are the ones who incited Ma Ling to violence; they are the ones who ultimately silenced her... Everyone here has blood on their hands, creating this deadly trap that consumes the manor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When did this begin? At the manor? The inn? Or even earlier? You were never going to let anyone walk away with that codex, even if Xu Shen and Ma Ling didn't make a move!

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Too late to figure it out now!

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: True or false, what does it matter to a dying soul? Best you go dumb to your grave!
The head of the walking stick arcs around and connects with the back of your knee. Your leg gives way, folding uncontrollably as he knocks you sprawling to the ground.

You've already burned that feint; it won't work again. Certain that you have no other means of escape, the old man plants his foot on the hem of your robe, pinning you in place as he lets out a triumphant laugh.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Heh. Amateur skills, and yet you've clung to life this long. Such a fine young body and raw talent, wasted. A pity, truly.

He leaps into the air, his stick whistling as he brings it high overhead. You sense the danger and ready your shackles, power surging in your palm. The moment you prepare to counter his strike, a sharp click of a tongue sounds from above.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Tsk, tsk, tsk. All that huffing and puffing at your age. That's bad for your health, you know.

Like a meteor descending in wrath, the Mountain Lord's figure crashes into Yin Yansheng, catching him squarely in the side. The collision blasts out a tempest of energy, shockwaves ripping through the space around them. Yin Yansheng cries out in pain as the force hurls him and his stick away like debris.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Do you always have to make such a dramatic entrance... The manor's been in complete chaos. Why are you only showing up now? Where have you been?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: What, same question twice? I didn't go anywhere. Right up there on the roof. Had some liquor, watched the stars, slept like a log. Oh, and the stars last night were beautiful, but the show was even better. Little birdie got herself chased clean around the manor by a pack of mangy old cats.
Xiaofeng speaks in a conversational tone, casually waving her hand to swat away the poison-laced bone spikes Yin Yansheng fires in retaliation, as if she were brushing aside flies.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: That birdie's got a nose for hiding spots, I'll give her that. Been prowling these parts for days, never once noticed there was someone curled up under that rubble pile near the back mountain.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Looked like it. Curled up tight as a little snowball, not a twitch. Poor thing, honestly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She's hurt...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Well... only one way to find out, yeah?
Without hesitation, you seize the moment as Xiaofeng forces Yin Yansheng back once more, swiftly darting toward the side window of the meeting hall.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Think you can flee?

Yin Yansheng has no intention of letting you escape so easily. Abandoning his fight with Xiaofeng, he whips his long stick forward. It shoots through the air like an arrow from a bow, aiming directly for your back.
Just as the blow is about to land, Xiaofeng's sharp claws flash. With a resounding thwack, she bats the stick away as if it were a child's toy.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, old-timer. He's off to see the birdie, so who's gonna keep me company now? Just you and me... let's make it a day to remember!
steps.female_content: Hey, old-timer. She's off to see the birdie, so who's gonna keep me company now? Just you and me... let's make it a day to remember!

steps.content: Yin Yansheng spins to face her, his face a mask of shock and fury, but his venomous skills are mere child's play against Xiaofeng's overwhelming power. She toys with him effortlessly, pinning him in place with no hope of escape.
As you turn to vanish into the swirling snow, Xiaofeng tosses something your way. You catch it, and your fingers close around a string of silver beast-taming bells.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Finding her won't save you! The Snowquell Arts belong to me! ME!
